requirements.condition: Every operating document names the existing kimi branch as the only canonical and writable branch; no document instructs contributors to create another branch or merge to main.
All documents preserve the user's exact six-phase order and do not mark a later phase complete before its evidence exists.
MASTER_SPEC and FLOORS_1_10_DESIGN agree on currencies, Dawn anti-farming, armament families, offline rules, input behavior, floor roles, stable IDs, and the nine canonical screens.
Every unvalidated number is visibly labeled SIMULATION_CANDIDATE and paired with a target range or a rejection threshold; no candidate is represented as proven balance.
The first session promises visible value inside five minutes, 1-10F in six to eight active minutes, one-touch combat response, early automation, and no mandatory repetitive tapping.

The progression contract avoids same-maximum Dawn farming, unbounded build multipliers, opaque formulas, one-hit-death baselines, forced advertisements, random-stat equipment, and idle income that skips multiple unseen districts.

The nine-screen architecture covers title/resume, battle/follow, tower browse, floor clear/shop slot, shop reconfiguration, cat roster, upgrades/build/armament with diagnosis, 10F boss, and district result/Dawn states without adding an undisclosed tenth screen.

The physical-device gate explicitly requires real iPhone Safari, standalone PWA, and ChatGPT in-app browser checks where available, including a three-minute maximum-effect boss run and a ten-minute continuous soak; it remains NOT_VERIFIED now.
PROJECT_STATUS.json parses successfully; Markdown contains no unresolved placeholder or contradictory status; repository runtime and asset bytes remain unchanged in this artifact.

An independent critic searches for cross-document contradictions, impossible timing, exploitable loops, and claims unsupported by the cited evidence, and all material findings are resolved before PASS.

Active operating status is consistent at Step 1 PASS and Step 2 onward NOT_STARTED; every active reference that names the current completion evidence points to acceptance-round-005.json; and Round 4 remains superseded history rather than current authority.

The Step 3 holdout bank is one-use for promotion: any externally materialized seed result, aggregate, verdict, or diagnostic spends it; observed results may not tune a candidate; partial materialization without a valid verdict also spends it; and a failure or later candidate or simulator-semantics change requires Step 1 re-seal with a disjoint unobserved bank plus a complete Step 2 rerun. The lifecycle preflight scans every historical bank ID, rejects calibration, spent, unresolved, overlapping or reassigned seed ranges, and permits only an adjacent non-overlapping range or an exact same-digest zero-output retry.

The executable input seal contains only immutable dependencies: exact raw bytes of candidate.schema.json, validate-candidate.mjs, executable-seal.schema.json and validate-executable-seal.mjs plus the canonical JSON digest of PROJECT_STATUS.json canonicalScreens, stableIdMigrationAliases and stableIdRegistry. Mutable workflow mirrors are excluded from balance-result invalidation and are separately bound to the reviewed-content commit/tree and evidence hashes recorded by Round 5.

Step 2 PASS creates a strict-schema one-way executable seal containing the exact candidate, complete fixed-root simulator source tree, run plan, result schema, result validator, Node version, raw dataset, summary and acceptance digests. The source list must equal the full recursive regular-file closure, local dynamic code loading is forbidden, Step 3 must match every field before any holdout draw, and Step 3 or workflow updates may not rewrite it.
